components.name: Text Field

narrative.overview: "Mesa" means table. The interface is a table set for someone who is hungry and in a hurry: a deep forest frame (rail, basket bar, selected chips) holds a pale mint-washed surface where real food photography does the talking. Green is the whole palette, but it works in three registers: forest for structure, mint for the one thing to press, evergreen for text that links or confirms. It is an Operate system: layout follows ordering conventions and expression lives in type, palette, photography and small precise details.
keyCharacteristics: Forest frame, mint action, mint-wash ground; white cards with a hairline and a soft green-tinted shadow.
Food photography is top-down, daylight, on a pale mint-white surface, always cropped with rounded corners.
Barlow carries names, headings and every number; Figtree Light carries descriptions.
One mint-filled primary action per region.
The basket and the live order status are always one glance away.

rules.name: The One Mint Rule
rules.body: Electric Mint marks the single most important action in a region. Two mint-filled buttons side by side means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Forest Frame Rule
rules.body: Structure is forest, never black and never mint. The rail, the floating basket bar and selected chips use Deep Forest.

rules.name: The Tinted Text Rule
rules.body: No neutral greys. Secondary text is Pine Grey, tertiary on dark is Sage; both carry the green hue.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Barlow Rule
rules.body: Prices, quantities, ETAs, order numbers and totals are always Barlow.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone; no small uppercase kicker above them.

rules.name: The Quiet Rest Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft and green-tinted (offset y, blur 8 to 24). No hard offset shadows, no colored glows.

dos: Do set page ground to Mint Wash (#F3FCF8) and cards to white; separate them with the hairline and the Card rest shadow.
Do use mint for exactly one primary action per region, and Forest for structure and selected states.
Do set every price, quantity, ETA and total in Barlow; descriptions in Figtree Light 14 to 15px.
Do use top-down daylight food photography on a pale mint-white surface; crop with FILL and round the corners.
Do show real states: in-basket stepper, sold out, required vs optional option groups, focus ring, empty basket, validation checklist.
Do draw icons as 1.75 to 2px line SVGs, in Evergreen on Mist tiles or Pine Grey/Sage when inactive.
Do keep fictional data consistent across screens: the same basket, totals, order number and courier everywhere.
donts: Don't use neutral greys, pure black or a yellow/orange accent; amber only for star ratings, rust only for "Cancelled".
Don't put an eyebrow/kicker above headings, use gradient text, glass blur for decoration, or colored side borders on cards.
Don't use emoji or text glyphs as icons.
Don't put two mint-filled buttons in the same region, or mint text on white (use Evergreen).
Don't nest cards inside cards, or build screens from identical icon-plus-heading-plus-text tiles.
Don't invent real brands, customers or claims; labelled demo content only.
Don't rely on DIN Neuzeit Grotesk or Avenir Light inside Figma; use Barlow and Figtree unless the user supplies the originals.
